$comment: The media rights inventory of the generic fixture: every image it delivers, where each came from (media/PROVENANCE.md), what is established and what is not. It asserts no right over any file. check:media fails if a delivered file has no entry or has changed since it was written.

statuses.unverified: nothing established about rights; the generation record exists
statuses.licence-text-shipped: a licence text and copyright notice are shipped with the file; the upstream source is not confirmed
statuses.verified: a rights-verification approval row names who verified, the sources and the date for this file

terms.title: The script that made the fixture images
terms.establishes: That the two images were drawn by the fixture script alone, from no third-party file, which a person confirms by reading media/PROVENANCE.md and running the script.

assets.description: 1200 x 675 WebP, an abstract grid of flat rectangles

origin.service: a script written for this fixture (Pillow), run locally

established: How the file was made is recorded in media/PROVENANCE.md: a script, no photograph, no model output, no third-party file.
notEstablished: That no person has to confirm the origin: the record is a statement by the engineering authors, not a verification.

assets.useNow: The generic fixture only, to test the STS engineering. It depicts nothing.
assets.clientUse: Not for a client site. A client replaces it with media whose origin and rights are recorded in a rights-verification approval.
